coordinateSystem: Original body-fixed radar-model Cartesian axes; positive Z is the selected spin pole; east-positive longitude; arbitrary display phase
source: Magri et al. (2007), Icarus 186, 152–177; Arecibo and NASA/JPL radar astronomy: ecliptic J2000 lambda 136 deg, beta 22 deg, period 6.13836 h; equatorial conversion uses J2000 obliquity 23.439291111 deg.
